open.heading:
Four routes,
{{chosen once}}
body: The stage opens up, and the only irreversible thing on it is the choice the school asks a student to make. Four streams, each taught to CBSE board level. What each contains — and how far each of those lists can be relied on — is set out on {' '}Subject Combinations.

beyond.heading:
and a galvanometer
{{measured properly.}}
body: Sunbeam students travelled to Delhi for an **international innovation project on entrepreneurship**, run with **Monash University, Australia** at K. R. Mangalam World School, G.K-II.

Closer to home and just as specific: in 2025 **Class XII-B** determined the internal resistance of a galvanometer and calculated its figure of merit by the half-deflection method. The school’s own note on it is four words — {' '}*“the practical, done properly.”*
The rest of what came back from the national and international programmes is on {' '}Student Success.

board.heading:
Board practicals
{{start here.}}
body: Class IX is the year the laboratory programme stops being introductory. Physics, Chemistry and Biology each carry **board practicals from Class IX to Class XII** — the same practicals a board expects a candidate to have done, in rooms built for one subject each.
The curriculum itself is published class by class as the school’s PRECEPT syllabus, session 2026-27.
Board outcomes are published separately, on {' '}Board Results, and are not restated here.

more.heading:
Learning that
{{goes further.}}
body: Labs, libraries, digital tools and activities that turn curiosity into capability — none of them added for the board years, all of them already there.
Every room above is on the school’s own {' '}facilities inventory; the twelve laboratories are set out on {' '}Laboratories & Academic Clubs.

close.heading:
A real venture,
{{and a clearer direction.}}
body: Senior Secondary is where preparation meets purpose. Four streams taught to board level, a galvanometer measured and its figure of merit calculated, and an innovation project carried to Delhi with an Australian university — every practical, every lesson and every project a step toward what comes next.
